items.name: Fizzing Focus Draught
items.effect: Ignore one minor environmental distraction on the next spell attempt this scene.

items.name: Spellgrip Wax
items.effect: For one scene, gain advantage against being disarmed by mundane means.

items.name: Silver Smoke Pellet
items.effect: Creates a brief 3 m obscured cloud that glitters around moving creatures.

items.name: Snapvine Cord
items.effect: Thrown cord attempts to bind a small object or already-controlled creature; single use.

items.name: Warming Pearl
items.effect: Keeps one person warm and functional for ten minutes in severe cold or wet.

items.name: Bottled Tailwind
items.effect: On breaking, pushes everything unsecured in a narrow 6 m line.

items.name: Flash Sugar
items.effect: Creates a harmless brilliant crackle when crushed.

items.name: Quiet Mint
items.effect: For one minute, the user's breath and involuntary noises are suppressed; deliberate speech ends it.

items.name: Quickseal Resin
items.effect: Seals one hand-sized crack against water or air for one scene.

items.name: Spider Salt
items.effect: A short line repels ordinary spiders and discourages giant spiders until disturbed.
